neighbours.label: variation or difference across cases (differ widely, variety, vary, depends on)
fire: Opinions on the new law differ widely among farmers.
The shop sells a wide variety of teas from around the world.
Rainfall varies greatly from one valley to the next.
The two species look similar but differ in the shape of their beaks.
Customs for weddings are very different in each region.
The final cost depends on the size of the order.
Results were highly variable across the test sites.
There is considerable diversity in the plants found on the island.
quiet: Opinions on the new law are shared by most farmers.
The shop sells a single brand of tea from India.
Rainfall is steady from one valley to the next.
The two species look similar and share the shape of their beaks.
Customs for weddings are very similar in each region.
The final cost is fixed at fifty dollars per order.
Results were highly consistent across the test sites.
There is a single kind of plant found on the island.

predictions: Fires weakly on words stating that something differs or varies across cases; quiet when the same sentence states sameness or a fixed value.
notes: Gate-closed regime dominates (63%). Card: different x8, depends x3, widely, variety, variable. Probes were weak: 'differ widely' 0.162, 'variety of' 0.194, 'vary' 0.082, 'depends on' 0.017, 'different layers' 0.035; controls 0.024-0.057. Low confidence.
